COMMON SIE QUESTIONS

Before you begin

What is the SIE exam?

The Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) exam is FINRA's introductory exam for people entering the securities industry. It has 75 multiple-choice questions, a 105-minute time limit, and covers four content areas. Read the study guides.

How many questions are on the SIE exam?

FINRA lists 75 questions. The content outline allocates 12 to Capital Markets, 33 to Products and Risks, 23 to Trading and Accounts, and 7 to the Regulatory Framework. Read the study guides.

What score do you need to pass the SIE?

FINRA lists a passing score of 70. A practice score can help identify what to review, but it cannot predict an official exam result. Read the study guides.

How should I use SIE practice questions?

Answer mixed questions regularly, read the explanation after every miss, then return to the domain that is costing you the most points. Save full timed mocks for checking your exam pacing. Read the study guides.

Does Bona Fide replace FINRA materials?

No. Bona Fide is an independent study tool. Its questions are written to the current FINRA outline, but candidates should still use FINRA's official content outline and exam information. Read the study guides.

Is Bona Fide available on iPad?

Yes. Bona Fide is built for iPhone and iPad. Your study progress stays on your device and the app does not require an account. Read the study guides.
